data.text: DOC-N in a document body is a derived label stored inside an event, which is what I7 warns against: labels come from ULID order, so a document added on another branch with a lower ULID shifts every label after it and every link pointing past it. Documents cannot be deleted - there is no doc.deleted event - so the single-owner case is safe. Parallel branches adding documents are not. If that becomes real, the migration script is deterministic and can republish the whole set with corrected links.
